overall_notes: This paper focuses on cross-modal robustness evaluation through text augmentation rather than NLG generation. The extracted metadata was generally accurate but needed normalization and some corrections. The paper evaluates how vision-language models perform on augmented text data but doesn't generate new language content from scratch.
